summary:
Successfully implemented KAFKA-20223: Extended I/O Metrics Collection

Changes made:
1. **LinuxIoMetricsCollector.java**: Added 5 new metrics (rchar, wchar, syscr, syscw, cancelled_write_bytes) with getter methods and parsing logic in updateValues()

2. **KafkaBroker.scala**: Registered 5 new Yammer metrics gauges for:
   - linux-disk-rchar
   - linux-disk-wchar
   - linux-disk-syscr
   - linux-disk-syscw
   - linux-disk-cancelled-write-bytes

3. **ControllerServer.scala**: Registered the same 5 new metrics for the KRaft controller

Test Results:
✓ LinuxIoMetricsCollectorTest - All tests PASSED (verifies reading and caching of all 7 metrics from /proc/self/io)
✓ MetricsTest::testLinuxIoMetrics() - PASSED (verifies all 7 metrics are registered in Kafka metrics system)
✓ All other MetricsTest tests - PASSED (no regressions)

The implementation now collects all 7 Linux I/O metrics as required by the KIP:
- read_bytes, write_bytes (existing)
- rchar, wchar, syscr, syscw, cancelled_write_bytes (newly added)
